==Active Ability: Verdant Enchantment==
[[File:VerdandEnchant.png|thumb]]
When activated, increases the Magic damage stats of units in her range by 50%. If Leafy buffs other Leafy´s in her range, their ability is going to buff by 100%. The buff lasts for 30 seconds and the ability has a cooldown of 60 seconds.
==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==
*She can do the infinite buff like [[Commander]] or [[Wind Dragon]].
*Also, she needs a negative SPA curse to do the infinite buff.
*{{PAGENAME}} have damage buffs against the [[Legend Stages#Virtual Dungeon (Bosses)|Virtual Dungeon (Bosses) Legend Stages]].
